items.rationale: RIGHT returns the text 42. In arithmetic Excel converts numeric-looking text, so 42 x 2 = 84.
A comparison does not convert text to a number, so the text 42 and the number 42 are different and the result is FALSE. It is not an error, which is why the problem is easy to miss.
RIGHT returns the text 42, XLOOKUP does not match text against numbers, and there is no fourth argument, so the result is #N/A. Multiplying by 1 first would fix it.
Three characters from the end are -38, including the hyphen. Excel converts the text -38 to the number -38, and -38 x 1 = -38. Always count the characters you really want.
